description: ## HOW TO ACCESS TRANSLATED CONTENT IN NPTEL SITE. ### ACCESS TRANSLATED CONTENT - LECTURE WISE. ## GO TO COURSE. Visit https://nptel.ac.in. Search for your desired course (course will be available only if translated in that language). Go to the course page. ## ACCESS TRANSLATED PDF. Click on desired language tab (tabs will be available only the course is translated in that language). Go to the specific lecture number. Click on "Download" link to view / save the translated content. ### ACCESS TRANSLATED EBOOK. ## Access E-Book via course page. Search for your desired course. "Click to Download" for viewing / saving the e-Book as PDF. ## Access E-Book. Click on "Download" against desired language. for viewing / saving the e-Book as PDF. ### ACCESS COURSE WISE TRANSLATED CONTENT. if so, click on "Click here" link against the course.
